rule.name: CachedEntityFieldNotSerializable
rule.message: This mapped field of a second-level cached entity (@Cacheable or Hibernate @Cache) holds a project type that is not Serializable (or a collection of them). A cache that serializes entries (Ehcache with off-heap or disk tiers, a distributed cache) throws NotSerializableException on the write, or skips the entry, while tests with an in-memory cache pass. Make the type implement Serializable (public abstract class Attribute implements Serializable), mark the field @Transient or transient, or cache the entity with a JSON serializer. An exception fits a cache that keeps entries by reference.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $mappings := ('Type', 'JdbcTypeCode', 'Convert'), $unserializable := function($t, $unit) { let $imported := $unit/ImportDeclaration[@ImportedSimpleName = $t/@SimpleName], $local := $unit//ClassDeclaration[@SimpleName = $t/@SimpleName], $root := string-join(tokenize($unit/PackageDeclaration/@Name, '\.')[position() le 2], '.') return exists($t[self::ClassType][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Object')][not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.Serializable'))]) and empty($local[@Interface = true()]) and (if (exists($imported)) then (some $i in $imported satisfies starts-with($i/@ImportedName, concat($root, '.'))) else (exists($local) or (empty($unit/ImportDeclaration[@ImportOnDemand = true()][@Static = false()]) and not($t/@SimpleName = ('Object', 'Iterable', 'Runnable', 'CharSequence', 'Thread', 'Process', 'Record', 'Comparable', 'AutoCloseable', 'ThreadLocal', 'Runtime'))))) } return //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[(@SimpleName = 'Cacheable' and not(.//BooleanLiteral[@True = false()])) or @SimpleName = 'Cache']] [ancestor::CompilationUnit/ImportDeclaration[@ImportedName = ('jakarta.persistence.Cacheable', 'javax.persistence.Cacheable', 'org.hibernate.annotations.Cache')]] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('static', 'transient'))] [ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = $mappings]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Transient'])] [let $unit := ancestor::CompilationUnit, $type := *[self::ClassType or self::ArrayType][1] return $unserializable($type, $unit) or (some $a in $type/TypeArguments/ClassType satisfies $unserializable($a, $unit))] /VariableDeclarator/VariableId
